== Notes ==

* When used against Charr, the [[Ebon Vanguard Assassin]] can survive long enough to complete up to two attack chains. When used against other foes, the Assassin only has enough time for a single attack chain.
** All its skills are [[Block|unblockable]]
** His [[Iron Palm]] will [[knock down]] foes that are [[hex]]ed or suffering from a [[condition]].
* You can create multiple Assassins in an area.
* It is not [[Infusion|infused]] nor does it leave an exploitable [[corpse]].
* When its summoning period ends, it appears to Shadow Step into nothingness.
* It will be higher than level 20 if cast under the effects of [[Signet of Illusions]] with an [[Illusion Magic]] rank 17 or more.

{{Anomaly|The Assassin doesn't shadow step; it is spawned directly next to the target.}}
{{Anomaly|The Assassin is counted as a ''created'' creature for [[Spirit's Gift]], [[Explosive Growth]], and [[Boon of Creation]]. However, it does not count as a [[summoned creature]] and is not affected by [[Spawning Power]]. Despite this classification, it is not affected by [[Sulfurous Haze|sulfur]].}}
{{Bug|Though the Assassin does not count towards the minion cap, summoning one will cause the game to check the players minion control limit, potentially destroying any minions over the limit.}}
{{Anomaly|The Assassin does not always target the foe targeted by the caster, but instead targets the foe closest to its creation point.}}
{{Bug| Very rarely, the assassin may survive indefinitely. This can occur if resurrected by an enemy-created [[Restoration]] spirit, as by [[Reborn Irukandji]].}}

== Trivia ==
*Assuming the Assassin is able to complete his combo, this summon has the highest consistent damage output among the five reputation-governed summons.
*Contrary to the skill icon, the summoned Assassin ironically does not wear [[Ebon Vanguard armor]].
